summary: A bridge posting is derived from a load rating computed at commissioning under an assumed traffic mix. The mix changed; the posting did not, and the figure travels downstream with no re-check interval attached to it.

signal_basis.prior_report: searched: nobody reported the mix change as a hazard
signal_basis.figure_without_clock: the rating carries no domain of validity and no next-check date
signal_basis.no_instrument: traffic counts exist and are collected

remedy.text: attach a domain of validity and a derived re-check interval to the posting

authoring_note: The claim-record route: a figure whose clock was stripped, which that folder refuses to store as a literal date and derives instead.

time_constant.why: the rate at which the traffic mix moves has not been measured. It is the neglected term and nobody has put a number on how fast it moves.

rate_ceiling.why: no bound on how fast the mix can change is recorded anywhere in the posting file.

coupling.why: the elasticity of the rating with respect to the mix is derivable by perturbation and has not been derived.

figure.note: Every sub-field is a stated absence with a reason, not an omission. That is the bin: the figure survived and the conditions under which it held did not, so the module that derives a clock returns UNDERIVABLE -- which is the bin restated by an instrument that did not know about it.
